## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      3 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Oct 28, 2026 - Nov 9, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Crazyaboutlistsandnotes_, Nov 9, 2026, 1/5: "Can’t tell if it’s promoting a sale and broken or if they really decided to turn the FREE functionality off and charge $20. If so, that’s silly and I made a replacement timer for free in claude in about 60 seconds."
            2. _aceruby8211_, Nov 2, 2026, 1/5: "Used to be a free app now suddenly pressing play on my timer brings up a paywall instead? Nothing on the store page makes any mention of this app costing money either. I do appreciate a one-time payment option but with how fishy the whole thing is I just don’t trust it. Don’t trust y’all not to go back on that lifetime unlock, frankly don’t trust yall with my credit card info, and don’t trust that the app will even work with all the reviews saying it just kept crashing after they paid. On top of that, $20 (or $3/month) is crazy for a pretty simple timer app, and completely insane that yall are claiming this is HALF OFF the full price for “loyal users”??"
            3. _jimbobmo_, Oct 31, 2026, 1/5: "I’ve been using this app for years and always loved it for my workouts, but the recent updates have completely ruined the experience. For a while, the app kept crashing and wouldn’t even open. Now, I can no longer use it at all. Whenever I try to start a timer, I’m prompted to subscribe to Premium. Even after closing the pop-up, it appears again as soon as I try to start the timer. There seems to be no way to use the app without paying for a subscription."
